description: Records what ACTUALLY happened on an experiment day: `followed` true or false (did the user do what that day's arm said), optional note. Only intervention and control days can be logged, not future days, not after a stop. `date` defaults to today; `id` defaults to the one experiment running today (required when none or several run). Logging a day again with a different answer keeps the earlier one under `earlier`. analyze_experiment reports intention to treat and per protocol, so honest logging, including false, matters. Local file only.

date.description: The day, YYYY-MM-DD (default today; not in the future).

followed.description: true: the user did what that day's arm said. false: not.

id.description: Experiment id (default: the one running today).

name: log_experiment_day
title: Log what actually happened on an experiment day
